spell-table.label: Cast a spell
spell-table.tool_text: The spell table can't cast a whole recipe yet. Soon. For now, keep looking around and I'll leave a treat or two out for you.

lectern.label: The occasion
lectern.ref: the open book on the lectern

music-box.label: The music box
music-box.moment: Lift the lid and she dances. Her tune changes with the weather.
music-box.moment_stop: Lid down. She'll wait for you.
music-box.moment_quiet: Lift the lid and she dances. Turn the sound on, by the bell, and you'll hear her tune.

jar-tart.label: The fruit tart
jar-tart.moment: Mostly fruit, held together with a bit of pastry and a lot of nerve.

jar-truffles.label: The truffles
jar-truffles.moment: Dates and cocoa, rolled by hand. Nobody believes me about the dates.

jar-pavlova.label: The pavlova
jar-pavlova.moment: Crisp outside, soft in the middle. Yoghurt on top instead of all that cream.

jar-parfait.label: The parfait
jar-parfait.moment: Yoghurt, berries and something crunchy, in layers. Pudding or breakfast, you decide.

sugar-pan.label: The sugar pan
sugar-pan.moment: Berries cooking down with a spoon of honey. That's the pink steam.

lane-window.label: The lane
lane-window.moment: The bakery over the road. We're friendly rivals.

window-seat.label: The window seat
window-seat.moment: Best seat in the house for watching the lane go by.

star-chart.label: The star chart
star-chart.moment: The kitchen constellations. That one's the Great Whisk.

ss-dial.label: The dial
ss-dial.map: The dial by the hallway door

atoms.title: Banana and oat pancakes
atoms.body: A ripe banana, two eggs and a handful of oats, blended and cooked in small rounds. Berries on top.

seed.name: Banana and oat pancakes
seed.why: A sweet breakfast with no added sugar.

atoms.title: A parfait in a glass
atoms.body: Yoghurt, berries and granola in layers, in a nice glass. Pudding or breakfast, you decide.

seed.name: Berry and yoghurt parfait
seed.why: A sweet start to the day.

atoms.title: Date and cocoa truffles
atoms.body: Soft dates, nuts and cocoa blitzed until they clump, rolled into balls and dusted in more cocoa.

seed.name: Date and cocoa truffles
seed.why: Something chocolatey to have with a cup of tea.

atoms.title: Lemon and yoghurt loaf
atoms.body: A simple loaf made with yoghurt and lemon zest, with a sharp lemon drizzle. Good with a cup of tea.

seed.name: Lemon and yoghurt drizzle loaf
seed.why: An afternoon tea cake to share.

atoms.title: Strawberries dipped in dark chocolate
atoms.body: Strawberries dipped halfway in melted dark chocolate and left on baking paper to set.

atoms.title: One-ingredient banana ice cream
atoms.body: Frozen banana slices blitzed until thick and smooth, like soft serve.

seed.name: Banana nice cream
seed.why: Ice cream from one ingredient on a hot day.

atoms.title: Frozen yoghurt bark
atoms.body: Thick yoghurt spread on a tray with berries, nuts and honey, frozen and snapped into shards.

seed.name: Frozen yoghurt and berry bark
seed.why: A cold treat to keep in the freezer.

atoms.title: Mango and lime ice lollies
atoms.body: Ripe mango blended with lime juice, poured into moulds and frozen. Expect sticky fingers.

seed.name: Mango and lime ice lollies
seed.why: Cold, fruity and made ahead for a hot day.

atoms.title: Baked pears with ginger and honey
atoms.body: Halved pears with grated ginger and honey, baked for twenty-five minutes. A spoon of yoghurt on top.

seed.name: Baked pears with ginger and honey
seed.why: A warm pudding for the evening.

atoms.title: Fruit crumble with an oat top
atoms.body: Soft fruit in a dish under a crumbly top of oats, flour, butter and nuts. Bake until it bubbles at the edges.

seed.name: Apple and berry crumble with an oat top
seed.why: A warm pudding that uses up fruit.

atoms.title: Chocolate pots for later
atoms.body: Dark chocolate melted into warm cream or coconut milk, poured into small cups and left in the fridge. Ready in a couple of hours.

seed.name: Little dark chocolate pots
seed.why: Ten minutes to make, then waiting in the fridge for later.

atoms.title: Little pavlovas with yoghurt and berries
atoms.body: Small meringue nests, baked low and slow, filled with thick yoghurt and berries just before serving.

seed.name: Mini pavlovas with yoghurt and berries
seed.why: A pudding to share at a celebration.

atoms.title: One square of dark chocolate, slowly
atoms.body: Break off one square of dark chocolate and let it melt on your tongue. It lasts longer than you'd think.

seed.name: Dark chocolate and almond bark
seed.why: A slab to break one square from at a time.

atoms.title: Why whole fruit is the gentlest sweet
atoms.body: Whole fruit brings fibre and water with its sugar, so it fills you up and goes in more slowly than sugar on its own.

atoms.title: Level up any sweet spell
atoms.body: A pinch of flaky salt on chocolate, lemon zest on berries, toasted nuts on yoghurt. Small changes you can taste.

seed.name: Berries with lemon zest and toasted almonds
seed.why: Three small finishes on one bowl.
